title: Rectangle Sums
statement:
Build a two-dimensional prefix sum table to answer inclusive rectangle sums.

Input
n m q, then n rows of m signed values, then q lines r1 c1 r2 c2 with valid 1-based corners in increasing order.

Output
One sum per query.

Constraints
1 ≤ n,m ≤ 1000, 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000. Values have absolute value at most 10⁹.
